promotion_pay_fixation.statutory_rules: Rule 10 & 11 Army Officers Pay Rules 2017; SRO 12(E) dated 03 May 2017
promotion_pay_fixation.deadline_description: Option must be exercised within 1 month from date of publication of promotion Part II Order / Gazette
promotion_pay_fixation.finality_rule: Option once exercised shall be final and cannot be revised
promotion_pay_fixation.default_if_not_exercised: Option 1 (Fixation from date of promotion) is applied automatically by default

option_1.name: Fixation from Date of Promotion
steps: 1. On date of promotion, grant one increment in the lower level from which promoted.
2. Place at a cell equal to that figure in the promotional level.
3. If no identical cell exists, place at the next higher cell in the promotional level.
4. Date of Next Increment (DNI) in promotional level is after 6 months (following 01 Jan or 01 July).

option_2.name: Fixation from Date of Next Increment (DNI) in Lower Post
steps: 1. From date of promotion until DNI, pay is fixed at the next higher stage in promotional level without promotional increment.
2. On DNI (01 Jan or 01 July), two increments are granted in the lower level (1st for annual increment, 2nd for promotion).
3. Place at a cell equal to that figure in the promotional level, or next higher cell if no identical figure exists.
4. First increment in the promotional grade is granted after 6 months on following 01 Jan or 01 July; thereafter every 12 months.
option_2.financial_advantage: Typically advantageous when promotion occurs 3-6 months before the officer's scheduled annual increment date.

promotion_to_major_general_rule.rule: One increment in Level 13A plus Military Service Pay (MSP ₹15,500) element determines placement cell in Level 14.

components.AAAAAA: Personal Account Number (6 digits unique to the officer)

sections.D_Section: Disbursement & Recoveries Section (DSOP, AGIF, Income Tax, License Fee)
